label: steel interface-theme background tile
source_note: SpriteCook's native output is 200 by 200 pixels at every export setting; this is the full-size generation.
derivation: Broad left-to-right brightness band removed: each column's mean brightness minus its 49-column wrapped moving average is kept, so grain is unchanged and the tile repeats without stripes. The unmodified generation is identified by source_sha256 and is not kept in the repository.
presentation_contract: Repeated in both axes without stretching behind menu-style screens for this interface theme, under a 20% wash of the backdrop colour and an edge vignette. Also laid faintly, at the player's panel-texture strength (10% by default), over framed panels and the play screen's own surfaces in both HUD layouts.
